	return parent:FindFirstChild(child)
end

local Entities = safeWait(workspace, "Entities")
local Entity = safeWait(Entities, player.Name)
local Simulator = safeWait(Entity, "NeonWingSimulator")
local SideValue = safeWait(Simulator, "Side")
local ModeValue = safeWait(Simulator, "Mode")

--====================================================
-- SKON
--====================================================
local function getCurrentSkin()
	local sideFolder = ModeData:FindFirstChild(SideValue.Value)
	if not sideFolder then return nil end

	local modeFolder = sideFolder:FindFirstChild(ModeValue.Value)
	if not modeFolder then return nil end

	local skinValue = modeFolder:FindFirstChild("SkinEquipped")
	if not skinValue then return nil end

	return skinValue
end

--====================================================
-- BEATBOX
--====================================================
local function updateMusic()
	local skinValue = getCurrentSkin()
	if not skinValue then return end

	if skinValue.Value == "" then
		return
	end

	local data = Skins[skinValue.Value]
	if not data then return end

	local newId = "rbxassetid://" .. data.Id
	if groovy.SoundId ~= newId then
		musicLabel.Text = data.Name
		groovy:Stop()
		groovy.SoundId = newId
		groovy:Play()
	end
end

--====================================================
-- INITIAL
--====================================================
updateMusic()

--====================================================
-- LISTENERS
--====================================================
ModeValue:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(updateMusic)
SideValue:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(updateMusic)

local function bindSkinListener()
	local skinValue = getCurrentSkin()
	if skinValue then
		skinValue:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(updateMusic)
	end
end

bindSkinListener()
ModeValue:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(bindSkinListener)
SideValue:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(bindSkinListener)
